monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral path from unit compatibility to label reading, exact-lot CoA review, edible arithmetic, and the existing price-and-label calculator. It keeps no purchase and a smaller or clearer package as valid outcomes and adds no merchant, live price, rating, discount, stock, product image, or invented test claim.

image_qa.note: The Blue Dream page retains the site's existing representative cannabis-flower image with explicit alt text and an on-page disclosure that it is not a verified cultivar or batch image. The final desktop and mobile page were visually checked. The potency guide and policy improvement add no image. No product, package, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is six days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, about 0.4% CTR, and average position 24.1. Blue Dream had 33 impressions, zero clicks, and average position about 47.6—the strongest non-legal page-volume signal—so the existing URL received a material evidence, intent, and internal-path expansion without a title rewrite or cannibalizing new page. The two-impression 510-versus-disposable row already has a complete exact-match page; Delaware's two impressions and remaining one-impression rows were deliberately ignored as too weak, duplicative, or irrelevant. Legacy sitemap submission errors remain an owner-side Search Console cleanup item; the canonical sitemap and static legacy recovery endpoint were preserved.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready cannabis potency-unit translator grounded in current New York OCM, California DCC, and NIST sources, with explicit formulas, invalid-conversion gates, a six-field record, and reciprocal links from established label, CoA, lab-limit, edible-math, and price-comparison pages. The Blue Dream field note adds a peer-reviewed sample-by-sample evidence matrix instead of recycling strain folklore. A source-review chronology release gate and public policy statement strengthen trust. One qualified New York consumer-education opportunity was logged; no outreach was sent.
